visual_thesis: A modern Agent workspace should make the conversation and current work dominant while moving account, files, tasks, recovery, and diagnostics into concise contextual controls.
content_plan: contextual account, workspace, task, fork, and resume controls

concepts.title: Calm Precision
concepts.prompt_direction: Bright editorial productivity workspace with a compact icon rail, session drawer, restrained indigo, and a tactile command composer; no permanent right sidebar or diagnostic tag row.
concepts.strength: The clearest, safest evolution of the existing product with excellent daylight readability.
concepts.tradeoff: The familiar sidebar composition is less visually radical than the other directions.

concepts.title: Midnight Operations
concepts.prompt_direction: Dark graphite Agent command workspace with cyan live signals, a broad transcript canvas, and a compact inline execution timeline.
concepts.strength: Feels most like a serious modern Agent and makes active tool work exceptionally clear.
concepts.tradeoff: A dark system requires more careful contrast, editor, and long-reading tuning.

concepts.title: Focused Canvas
concepts.prompt_direction: Warm porcelain spatial workspace with a slim dark rail, floating session palette, coral action color, and a restrained layered-paper seed motif.
concepts.strength: Most distinctive and human, with the prompt surface as the unmistakable focal point.
concepts.tradeoff: The illustrative motif and floating palette add more visual personality and implementation effort.
